title: host.license (platform → host)
description: The platform's Auto Tournament license for the servers it owns on this host (csm 1.22+): the key (null: none, free use), the lease (the license's current terms, signed, marked lease; the key never changes on renewal), and what the license server last said. csm writes it into those servers' Ready Up config and limits the platform's creates by it; a host's own key (csm license set) is never overwritten. Sent after welcome and whenever any of it changes. Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id).

revision.description: the platform's name for this exact key + lease + state (the hold poll's license.revision)
